name: sjskills-maintenance
description: Check CLI, configured skills, and published plugin status at startup without assigning agent work.

interface.shortDescription: Report actionable sjskills status at startup.
interface.longDescription: New and resumed sessions run direct read-only status checks. Healthy checks stay silent; actionable or incomplete checks produce one diagnostic. Updates and synchronization require a separate request.
interface.defaultPrompt: Explain my sjskills startup check findings.
